fichas.title: Line types and thicknesses in construction drawings
fichas.summary: A reference table specifies line types, their applications, line-group widths, and text sizes for construction drawings. It distinguishes section boundaries, visible and hidden edges, dimensioning lines, section-plane indicators, axes, and elements in front of or over the section plane. Notes describe when line groups I and IV are used and recommend standard line widths for drawings made with ink and standardised equipment.

fichas.title: Dimensioning conventions and units
fichas.summary: Dimensioning comprises a dimension figure, dimension line, extension line and dimension arrow. Figures are normally placed above the continuous dimension line and arranged to be readable from below or from the right. Dimension lines are solid and parallel to the measured length; extension lines move dimensions outside the area when they cannot be placed directly at its edge. The page illustrates alternative dimension units and dimensioning outside a drawing, including a note that millimetres are a recent trend and standard practice in the UK.
